info.name: GitHub Sync Fork Branch with the Upstream Repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs: Sync a branch of a forked repository to keep it up-to-date with the upstream repository.

info.name: GitHub Sync Ldap Mapping for Team

params.name: team_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the team.

items.docs: Note that this API call does not automatically initiate an LDAP sync. Rather, if a `201` is returned, the sync job is queued successfully, and is performed when the instance is ready.
